header.name: Cement
header.authors_and_contributors: Muhammad Salman (University of Liège), Rafailia Mitraki (University of Liège), Daniel Flórez-Orrego (EPFL IPESE research group), Grégoire Léonard (University of Liège)
header.description: Cement production with a dry short kiln: raw meal grinding, cyclone pre-heater, pre-calciner, rotary kiln and clinker cooler, cement mills for six products (CEM I, CEM II/B-W, CEM II/B-S, CEM II/B-LL, CEM III/A and LC3), a flash clay calciner for LC3, and an air separation unit for oxygen. It is the base plant of the superstructure of fuel switching, electrification, CO2 capture and waste heat recovery options assessed by Salman et al.

units.unit_description: This unit grinds and dries the raw materials into 792,000 kg/h of raw meal in a double rotator mill, which can grind even the hardest and most abrasive materials. The raw meal is heated from 18 to 99.5 °C and part of its moisture evaporates.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes limestone, clay, sand, slag, sludge and electricity, and delivers raw meal and the evaporated moisture.

connectors.name: RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Raw meal to the kiln pre-heater

connectors.name: CO2_IN_FLUE_GAS
connectors.description: Moisture evaporated in the mill. The Lua file puts it on the CO2_in_flue_gas layer

units.heat_streams_description: The raw meal is heated in five steps from 18 to 99.5 °C, and its moisture evaporates at 99.5 °C.

heat_streams.name: rawmill_dr_solidsheat_qt6
heat_streams.description: Moisture of the raw meal evaporated at 99.5 °C

units.unit_description: This unit is the four-stage cyclone pre-heater of the dry kiln. It heats two raw meal streams with the hot gas rising from the pre-calciner: the raw meal from the raw mill, 362,600 kg/h, and the pre-calcined raw meal on its way to the kiln, 257,250 kg/h.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the raw meal, the pre-calcined raw meal and the pre-calciner flue gas, and delivers the pre-heated raw meal to the pre-calciner, the pre-calcined raw meal to the kiln and the flue gas. The CO2 of the flue gas is also counted on a separate layer, for capture modelling.

connectors.name: RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Raw meal from the raw mill

connectors.name: PCHT_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-calcined raw meal from the pre-calciner

connectors.name: CO2_IN_FLUE_GAS
connectors.description: CO2 of the pre-calciner, counted for capture modelling

connectors.name: PH_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-heated raw meal to the pre-calciner

connectors.name: PC_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-calcined raw meal to the rotary kiln

units.heat_streams_description: Each heat stream is the sensible heat of a raw meal stream in one temperature interval of the pre-heater.

heat_streams.name: kilnph_qt5
heat_streams.description: Pre-calcined raw meal heated from 900 to 910 °C

units.unit_description: This unit is the pre-calciner, where most of the calcination of the limestone (CaCO3 → CaO + CO2) takes place, at 900 °C. The tertiary air from the clinker cooler and the hot kiln gas supply heat to it.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the pre-heated raw meal, and delivers the pre-calcined raw meal and its flue gas, which goes to the pre-heater.

connectors.name: PH_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-heated raw meal from the pre-heater

connectors.name: PCHT_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-calcined raw meal, back to the pre-heater

connectors.name: PC_PH_FLUE_GAS
connectors.description: CO2 of the calcination, to the pre-heater

units.heat_streams_description: The raw meal is heated to 900 °C and calcined. The tertiary air and the kiln gas are cooled to 425 °C.

heat_streams.name: kilnpc_qt2
heat_streams.description: Calcination of the raw meal at 900 °C

units.unit_description: This unit is the short dry rotary kiln, where the pre-calcined raw meal is sintered into 245,000 kg/h of clinker at up to 1444 °C. The solids are described by eight temperature nodes, and the secondary air from the clinker cooler is the combustion air.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the pre-calcined raw meal and electricity, and delivers hot clinker to the cooler, the kiln gas and its CO2.

connectors.name: PC_RAW_MEAL
connectors.description: Pre-calcined raw meal from the pre-heater

connectors.name: FUMES_DIVERSE
connectors.description: Kiln flue gas, including the secondary air

connectors.name: CO2_IN_FLUE_GAS
connectors.description: CO2 of the kiln gas, counted for capture modelling

units.heat_streams_description: Each heat stream is the heat load of one solid temperature node of the kiln. Nodes 8 and 7 have a negative load in the Lua file, so they are hot streams. The secondary air is cooled from 1078 to 425 °C.

heat_streams.name: kiln_dry_sairheat_qt9_HOT
heat_streams.description: Secondary air cooled from 1078 to 425 °C in the kiln

units.unit_description: This unit is the grate clinker cooler. The clinker is cooled from 1444 °C with air, which is heated to 1078 °C as secondary air for the kiln and to 247 °C as grate exhaust air. The clinker heat between 300 and 65 °C is available for heat recovery (BAT 2013). The investment of the whole kiln train is given on this unit.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the hot clinker and delivers the cooled clinker to the cement mills. The air connectors of the Lua file are disabled.

connectors.name: CLINKER
connectors.description: Cooled clinker to the cement mills

units.heat_streams_description: The cooling air is heated by the clinker. The clinker cooling below 300 °C belongs to the HREC heat cascade.

heat_streams.description: Cooling air heated from 20 to 1078 °C, to the kiln

heat_streams.description: Cooling air heated from 20 to 247 °C, to the grate exhaust

heat_streams.name: kilncc_dry_HREC
heat_streams.description: Clinker cooled from 300 to 65 °C, for heat recovery

units.unit_description: This unit grinds 450,000 kg/h of LC3, with 23,266 kW of electricity. Its specific grinding energy is that of CEM I for now.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes the mix, electricity, water and grinding aid, and delivers the cement.

connectors.name: MILLPROD6_MIX
connectors.description: Mix from the LC3 feed unit

units.unit_description: This unit calcines 100,000 kg/h of kaolinite clay at 800 °C in a flash calciner (FLSmidth process), into 82,990 kg/h of calcined clay for LC3 cement. Flash calcination gives a more reactive product than a rotary kiln, which can replace 30 to 40 % of the clinker, needs no grinding after the calciner and costs 75 % less. It is added to the problem only when add_ClayCal is 1.
units.connectors_description: The unit takes clay and electricity, and delivers calcined clay. The steam released is not given as a connector.

connectors.name: CALCINED_CLAY
connectors.description: Calcined clay (metakaolin) to the LC3 mill

units.heat_streams_description: The clay is dried and heated to 800 °C and calcined; the calcined clay and the steam are cooled.

heat_streams.name: cca_heating_clay
heat_streams.description: Clay heated from 15 to 800 °C, with its moisture evaporated

heat_streams.name: cca_calcination_heat
heat_streams.description: Dehydroxylation of kaolinite into metakaolin at 800 °C

units.equipments_description: One flash calciner, scaled with an exponent of 0.6.

units.unit_description: This unit produces oxygen at 95 % purity by cryogenic air separation, with temperature swing adsorption (TSA) to remove the CO2, water and heavy hydrocarbons from the air. At its reference size it separates 10,000,000 kg/h of air into 1,580,000 kg/h of oxygen. It is added to the problem only when the cement plant has CO2 capture with a CO2 purification unit or calcium looping (add_ASU).
units.connectors_description: The unit takes compressed air and electricity, and delivers oxygen and nitrogen.
units.heat_streams_description: The TSA beds are regenerated with low pressure steam at up to 200 °C.

heat_streams.name: TSA_regeneration
heat_streams.description: Regeneration of the TSA beds from 15 to 200 °C

units.equipments_description: One ASU, scaled with an exponent of 0.6.
